name: r3-dispatch-encoder-write-faults-scoped
_comment: S1 (dispatch r3), scoped: a scoped actor open whose expectation insert or attempt claim fails inside the encoder. Record with --scoped.

steps.sql: CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_exp BEFORE INSERT ON valve_actuation_expectations WHEN NEW.device_eui='A84041000000206E' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 expectation fault'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER r3_fault_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF transport_json ON valve_actuation_expectations WHEN NEW.device_eui='A84041000000306E' AND NEW.transport_json LIKE '%ATTEMPTED%' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'r3 claim fault'); END;
